title: German Bratwurst Burger
description: A twist on the classic burger, featuring a spicy German bratwurst and topped with a variety of savory ingredients. Perfect for a casual dinner or outdoor gathering.

ingredients.name: Caramelized Onions
ingredients.notes: Cooked for 20 minutes in a pan with 1 tablespoon of oil

instructions: 1. Preheat a grill to medium-high heat.
2. Grill the bratwurst sausages for 5-7 minutes on each side, until browned and cooked through.
3. Meanwhile, toast the burger buns on the grill for a few minutes.
4. Assemble the burgers by spreading German mustard on the bottom bun, followed by a cooked bratwurst, a slice of cheese, a spoonful of sauerkraut, and finally the top bun.
5. Top with caramelized onions, lettuce, and tomato.
